# The Lantern

## One line

Makes light while it is held.

## What it actually is

A wick in a glass case, with a handle and no switch.

## How it is operated

1. Hold the handle.
2. Trim the wick.
3. Raise the glass.

## Physical side effects

1. A smell of oil.
2. A shadow that moves with the carrier.

## Cannot

Burn while it is on the ground.

## Costs

| Cost | Amount | Paid by |
|---|---|---|
| oil | one flask a night | the carrier |

## Constraints

It must stay above the snow (`[[rule:D1]]`).

## Jargon

| Term | Means | Who says it |
|---|---|---|
| the quiet | darkness | the Wardens |

## History

Built before the first winter (K1).
